[FACT] User is planning a trip to Osaka.  
[FACT] User recently went to Kyoto with friends from work about 2 months ago.  
[EVENT] User had an amazing time trying local cuisine in Kyoto.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Osaka is a food lover's paradise and offers delicious local specialties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-try dishes in Osaka include Takoyaki, Okonomiyaki, Kushikatsu, Ramen, and Fugu (Blowfish).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Osaka include Dotonbori Ichiran (Ramen), Kukuruza (Takoyaki), Okonomiyaki Mizuno (Okonomiyaki), Kushikatsu Tanaka (Kushikatsu), and Zuboraya (Fugu).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other tips include visiting Dotonbori, Shinsekai, and exploring food alleys (yokocho) throughout Osaka.  
[FACT] User is interested in kaiseki, the multi-course meal they fell in love with in Kyoto.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kaiseki restaurants in Osaka include Kani Doraku (3-Michelin stars), Sakamoto (2-Michelin stars), and Hajime (2-Michelin stars).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Alternative options include Edomae-style sushi restaurants, fugu kaiseki, Kyoyasai restaurants, and omotenashi-style restaurants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for kaiseki dining include making reservations in advance, being prepared for higher costs, and learning basic Japanese phrases.  
[EVENT] User is thinking of staying in a hotel or ryokan within walking distance to Dotonbori.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended ryokans include Ryotei Sakura, Yamatoya Honten, and Kagiya.
